Gianna Willcox

ALAMEDA, Calif. — Today, Alveo Technologies and AgriNerds Inc., announced a strategic partnership to create a new system of surveillance that alerts farmers of highly pathogenic avian influenza risks near their farms.

AgriNerds developed the Waterfowl Alert Network, a first-off-its-kind dynamic surveillance and awareness program that predicts historic and daily waterfowl activity around the nation’s poultry and livestock farms, Alveo said in the partnership announcement.

This partnership will pair the WAN with Alveo’s own unique, quick, molecular diagnostic to develop a proprietary system that uses a combination of satellite imagery, weather radar, and telemetry to create daily farm-level HPAI risk scores based on remote sensing and HPAI surveillance data, Alveo added.

Since the current HPAI outbreak began in 2022, poultry producers have heavily invested in improving their biosecurity practices to fight against HPAI and other pathogens. However, farms have continued to struggle with HPAI outbreaks.

This is mainly because of migratory birds. In fact, migratory birds have been the source of infection for 68 percent of U.S. H5N1 outbreaks since 2022, according to APHIS.

To combat these outbreaks, producers usually use one of two strategies for testing. Most tests are administered only when animals display flu-like symptoms, but this approach risks detecting the virus too late to prevent it from spreading, Alveo noted.

Some conduct periodic blind surveillance testing, which has the advantage of enabling early detection, but can be expensive, Alveo added. This new system will allow farmers to get ahead of the outbreak before it even begins.

Alveo and AgriNerds’ new rapid and targeted approach is dynamic surveillance that warns farmers when the risk of infection is high. AgriNerds’ Waterfowl Alert Network will use radar imagery to detect migratory bird movements, analyze the data using AI-powered pattern recognition software, and generate daily risk scores it shares with customers, Alveo explained.

Then, when risk escalates, Alveo’s on-site molecular test will help farmers to run asymptomatic surveillance testing that provides accurate results in less than an hour. This targeted, risk-based testing approach is designed to lower costs and increase effectiveness, so farmers can detect the virus early and reduce its spread, Alveo noted.

“To stop the spread of HPAI, producers need tools that will enable them to monitor risk and, when it’s elevated, employ rapid, accurate tests so they can take quick action and prevent further infection,” Shaun Holt, Alveo Technologies CEO, said. “This dynamic solution will aggregate and simplify rich data from AgriNerds and deliver sophisticated risk assessments to user phones in a simple red, yellow and green format. They can then run surveillance tests based on informed risk and rapidly respond if bird flu is detected.”

The two organizations will use this feedback loop to strengthen the accuracy of risk assessments over time, Alveo said. As more test data comes in across the nation and throughout the year, the alerts and testing guidance will become more accurate and valuable, protecting the nation’s food supply and the producers’ businesses.

“Biosecurity extends far beyond the facility’s fence line. Our Waterfowl Alert Network gives farmers visibility into the dynamic risk landscape around their operations,” Maurice Pitesky, University of California-Davis professor and co-founder of AgriNerds, said. “When paired with Alveo’s testing capability and rapid results, farmers can respond to real risks in real time. In this way, agriculture can move past reactive disease management to adopt a proactive, risk-informed approach.”

For more information about AgriNerds and the WAN, visit https://www.agrinerds.com. For more information about Alveo, visit https://www.alveotechnologies.com/.

translationZh:
加利福尼亚州阿拉米达——今日，Alveo Technologies与AgriNerds Inc.宣布建立战略合作伙伴关系，共同创建一套新型监测系统，在养殖场附近存在高致病性禽流感风险时向养殖户发出警报。

AgriNerds开发了Waterfowl Alert Network（水禽预警网络，简称WAN），这是一个首创的动态监测与预警项目，可预测全美家禽和畜牧养殖场周边历史及每日水禽活动情况，Alveo在合作公告中表示。

此次合作将WAN与Alveo独有的快速分子诊断技术相结合，开发一套专有系统，利用卫星图像、天气雷达和遥测技术的组合，基于遥感和HPAI监测数据生成每日养殖场级别的HPAI风险评分，Alveo补充道。

自2022年当前HPAI疫情暴发以来，家禽养殖户已在改善生物安全措施方面投入巨资，以对抗HPAI及其他病原体。然而，养殖场仍持续面临HPAI疫情暴发的困扰。

这主要是因为候鸟。事实上，根据APHIS的数据，自2022年以来，美国68%的H5N1疫情暴发源头为候鸟。

为应对这些疫情，养殖户通常采用两种检测策略之一。大多数检测仅在动物出现流感样症状时进行，但这种方法存在风险——检测到病毒时可能已为时过晚，无法阻止其传播，Alveo指出。

部分养殖户会进行定期盲测监测，其优势在于能够实现早期检测，但成本较高，Alveo补充道。这套新系统将使养殖户能够在疫情暴发之前提前采取行动。

Alveo和AgriNerds的新型快速靶向方法是一种动态监测方案，在感染风险较高时向养殖户发出警告。AgriNerds的Waterfowl Alert Network将利用雷达图像检测候鸟迁徙动态，通过AI驱动的模式识别软件分析数据，并生成每日风险评分与客户共享，Alveo解释道。

当风险升级时，Alveo的现场分子检测将帮助养殖户进行无症状监测检测，在一小时内提供准确结果。这种靶向的、基于风险的检测方法旨在降低成本并提高效率，使养殖户能够及早发现病毒并减少其传播，Alveo指出。

“要阻止HPAI的传播，养殖户需要能够监测风险的工具，并在风险升高时采用快速、准确的检测手段，以便迅速采取行动防止进一步感染，”Alveo Technologies首席执行官Shaun Holt表示。“这套动态解决方案将整合并简化来自AgriNerds的丰富数据，以简单的红、黄、绿格式向用户手机推送精准的风险评估。养殖户可以基于知情风险开展监测检测，并在检测到禽流感时快速响应。”

两家机构将利用这一反馈循环，随时间推移不断增强风险评估的准确性，Alveo表示。随着全国范围内全年检测数据的不断积累，警报和检测指导将变得更加精准和有价值，从而保护国家食品供应和养殖户的业务。

“生物安全远远超出养殖场围栏的范围。我们的Waterfowl Alert Network让养殖户能够洞察其运营周边动态的风险态势，”加州大学戴维斯分校教授兼AgriNerds联合创始人Maurice Pitesky表示。“与Alveo的检测能力和快速结果相结合，养殖户可以实时应对真实风险。通过这种方式，农业可以超越被动式疾病管理，转向主动的、基于风险防控的方法。”

有关AgriNerds和WAN的更多信息，请访问https://www.agrinerds.com。有关Alveo的更多信息，请访问https://www.alveotechnologies.com/。
